🎥🎬: Carrie (2026)

Carrie White is a quiet teenager trying to survive high school while dealing with relentless bullying and the suffocating control of her deeply religious mother, Margaret. After years of being treated like an outsider, Carrie begins to realize there is something extraordinary—and dangerous—inside her.

As the pressure around her intensifies, Carrie’s telekinetic powers become harder to control. What starts as small signs of anger quickly grows into something terrifying, especially as the people around her continue pushing her toward her breaking point.

When Carrie finally unleashes the power she has been hiding, the balance of power changes completely. The girl everyone thought was helpless becomes someone nobody can afford to underestimate.
